title: Conditional Decisions: The if Statement
subtitle: Guarding Code with Conditions
description: Practice decision branches across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
age = 20
# Stage 1: If age >= 18, print "Eligible to vote"

challenges.title: Stage 1: Voting Age Check
challenges.description: Given <hlt>age = 20</hlt>, write <hlt>if age >= 18:</hlt> and indent <hlt>print("Eligible to vote")</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
age = 20
# Stage 1: Check age eligibility (>= 18)
if age >= 18:
    print("Eligible to vote")

challenges.title: Stage 2: High Temperature Alert
challenges.description: Given <hlt>temperature = 35</hlt>, write <hlt>if temperature > 30:</hlt> to output <hlt>"Hot day"</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
temperature = 35
# Stage 2: Check temperature (> 30)
if temperature > 30:
    print("Hot day")
